#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int count;
    cin >> count;
    cin.ignore();
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);

    int maxOutside = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;
    int currentOutside = 0;
    int flags = 0;

    int i = 0;
    while (i < count) {
        char c = s[i++];

        if (c == '(') {
            if (currentOutside > maxOutside) maxOutside = currentOutside;
            currentOutside = 0;
            flags |= 1;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            flags &= ~1;
            if ((flags & 2) != 0) insideWords++;
            flags &= ~2;
        } else if (c == '_') {
            if (currentOutside > maxOutside) maxOutside = currentOutside;
            currentOutside = 0;
            if ((flags & 2) != 0) insideWords++;
            flags &= ~2;
        } else {
            if ((flags & 1) != 0) flags |= 2;
            else currentOutside++;
        }
    }

    if (currentOutside > maxOutside) maxOutside = currentOutside;
    cout << maxOutside << " " << insideWords << endl;

    return 0;
}
